model_output.verdict: Your work with founders and a CEO makes executive support a clear fit, and the freelance role shows you support several leaders at once. I’d move this forward. What were you doing between June 2023 and February 2025?
write_up: You moved from administrative support at Parkway Logistics to supporting its CEO, and now work independently with founders. Your resume makes that progression easy to follow. A few coordination duties still leave a recruiter guessing what you handled.

The leadership offsite is a useful model: you name the event, your role in it and its 40 attendees. There’s also an unaccounted stretch between leaving Parkway and starting your current work, even though your latest role is clearly dated.

Start with the investor meetings in your freelance role, then add detail to the board and department-head work at Parkway. A line accounting for the time between those roles would let a recruiter stay focused on your executive support work.
